summary: Frontend-only test of /calculator lease mode (Playwright at 1920 and 390, plus vitest). All requested features work: lease defaults ($1,902/mo, subline '36 mo · 10,000 mi/yr · MF 0.00285 (6.84% APR)', residual hint 58.0% / $92,220, NY tax label), state tax-method switching (CA monthly tax $157 and $2,056/mo; TX upfront tax $9,375), mileage adjustment (15k gives 55.5%, $88,245, $2,001/mo), slider updates live (65 gives 62.5% / $99,375), MF Edit/Auto (prefill 0.00285, custom 0.001 gives MF 0.00100 (2.40% APR), stays custom when tier changes, Auto restores sub 0.00520), tier change updates mf-readonly when not custom, 1% rule caption flips (cash down 60k gives 'Beats the 1% rule'), finance defaults unchanged ($2,573/mo, 72 months at 7.4% APR), finance and lease terms independent and kept when switching modes, blank fields show no NaN/Infinity, minus sign stripped, no horizontal overflow (390 and 1920), 2 columns on desktop and stacked on mobile, no console errors. yarn test: 10/10 passed (vitest).

ui_bugs.issue: Per $1,000 MSRP is shown in whole dollars (formatUsd), so the default shows '$12' instead of ~$11.96. Near the boundary, values like $10.40 display as '$10' next to 'Above the 1% rule', which looks contradictory. Use 2 decimals.
When the custom MF input is blank, the results fall back to the tier MF (subline shows MF 0.00285), but the helper text under the field shows '≈ 0.00% APR equivalent'. The two displays disagree.
When MSRP and selling price are both blank (msrp=0), per-1k shows $0 with 'Beats the 1% rule', which is misleading. Consider showing a dash or hiding the caption when msrp <= 0.
The custom MF input has no onKeyDown guard like NumberField. The minus sign is stripped by replace, but 'e'/'+' can still be typed.

action_items: Optional: MoneyFactorField APR helper should use the effective MF (tier fallback) when the custom value is blank
Optional: handle msrp=0 in the per-1k caption
Optional: add the same keydown guard to the customMF input
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentCalculator passes toNum() numbers to calcLease, so the lib's fallbacks (e.g. acquisitionFee default 995 when invalid) never apply for blank input; blank becomes 0. This is consistent and fine, just noting it.
mfEdit prefills with lease.tier.leaseMoneyFactor via closure; works correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (4 low-priority polish items)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Lease mode fully verified in iteration 10. Use 'yarn test' (vitest), not '--watchAll'. Expected values: NY default $1,902, CA $2,056 (monthly tax $157), TX $1,904 (upfront $9,375), 15k miles $2,001, custom MF 0.001 gives $1,478.
